sections.appearance: She has white hair with black bangs and a black ponytail tied to her horns. She has red eyes, pale skin and a mole in her lower neck. Halo ==== Kayoko's halo has a white pentagon with three sharp points and another upside-down pentagon inside. Uniform ==== She wears a black hoodie with the service logo written "Born.To.Kill" on it with red lines on the sleeves, a standard uniform underneath with brown t-shirt, pleated, plaid red skirt and black sneakers with red lines. She carries a black bag with white crude seams hanging on her right shoulder which also has a gun holster attached to the strap. Firearm ==== thumb|Demon's Roar|150px She uses a two-tone Heckler & Koch P30 pistol with a black suppressor. The slide and grip are chromed in silver while the receiver is colored grey. The school's name is imprinted on the left side of the receiver.

sections.personality: Unlike the lively characteristics each Problem Solver 68 members have, Kayoko is actually composed and the most reasonable out of the group. She is often mistaken as a troublemaker due to her scary front, but she's actually just going wherever the club takes her. She doesn't look for trouble and is only trying to avoid commotions, which is one of the reasons she's into music, specifically metal, where her ears can be drowned in music instead of surrounding noise.
